name: costa-rica-payroll
description: Use this skill to run Costa Rica payroll in 2026. It covers the employer's monthly withholding of the salary tax (impuesto al salario) on the 2026 table of Decreto Ejecutivo 45333-H (not subject to CRC 918,000 a month, then 10%, 15%, 20% and 25%), the monthly family credits (CRC 1,710 per child, CRC 2,590 for the spouse), the deduction of the worker's 10.83% social charges and the employer's 26.83% from the CCSS table, the planilla calendar and what is still open (aguinaldo, minimum wages). Trigger phrases include planilla Costa Rica, impuesto al salario 2026, retencion salario, cargas sociales, salario neto Costa Rica and TRIBU-CR retenciones.
